reasons.text: The single-storey side extension is subordinate to the house and acceptable in design (H4).
The protected beech T3 has a root protection area radius of 4.2 m and the new wall is 7.5 m away, outside it, so ENV3's method-statement requirement is not engaged.

citations.quote: The proposed wall at 7.5 m lies outside the root protection area of T3.
